narrow: inhibition of host transcription initiation by virus
suppression by virus of host DNA-dependent transcription, initiation
suppression by virus of host transcription initiation from RNA polymerase II promoter

definition: Any process in which a virus stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the assembly of the RNA polymerase II preinitiation complex (PIC) at an RNA polymerase II promoter region of a host DNA template. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: Inhibition of host transcription initiation by virus
